event_model_redesign.defect_repaired: Previous implementation required actual_release_utc and rejected upcoming events. Repaired model decouples scheduled metadata from released values.

upcoming_event_rules.unreleased_actual_rule: actual_value must be null when available_at_utc > snapshot_time_utc
upcoming_event_rules.causal_violation_rule: actual_value != null with future available_at raises CAUSAL_VIOLATION and fails closed

intraday_usability.EXACT: Potentially usable for intraday historical reconstruction

event_model_redesign.live_first_seen_rule: available_at_utc must not precede first_seen_at_utc unless verified exact official publication timestamp is declared under historical reconstruction mode with source_reference and source_hash.
